name: Extension raw object pointers require a native payload fixture

input.fixture_ref: A native extension stores an external pointer in runtime-owned payload storage and attempts to expose that pointer to Iris source as an address.

applicability.reason: No native fixture exposes extension payload pointer conventions or a script-visible raw-address channel.

expect.status: Only non-managed pointers remain internal payload or resource records; Iris source receives no raw managed or extension object address.
